title: Alibaba LingmaAgent: Improving Automated Issue Resolution via Comprehensive Repository Exploration

key_numbers.metric: SWE-bench Lite resolved rate vs SWE-agent
Function-level fault localization accuracy vs SWE-agent

stop_detail: Repository is top-down organized into a hierarchical AST-based structure tree extended with a function-call reference graph, then dynamically explored via Monte Carlo Tree Search with LLM-scored rewards to acquire context (§3.2-3.3).

title: Hierarchical Context Pruning: Optimizing Real-World Code Completion with Repository-Level Pretrained Code LLMs
stop_detail: Builds a function/class/file dependency graph via Tree-Sitter import parsing with BFS dependency levels D0..Dinf, then uses embedding-based top-k/top-p similarity ranking to select and prune function bodies (full content for current file, headers-only for low-relevance functions elsewhere), assembled hierarchically at prompt-construction time (Sec. 3, 'Hierarchical Context Pruning').

title: Evolving Triple Knowledge-Augmented LLMs for Code Translation in Repository Context

title: MRCoder: An Efficient Context Selecting Approach for Repository-Level Code Generation

key_numbers.value: up to 52.1% vs RAG; 47.6% vs RepoFormer

stop_detail: Map phase partitions retrieved candidates into fixed-size groups, has a lightweight LLM draft code per group, then Structure-Aware Draft-Guided Selection keeps contexts whose APIs match the draft's calls (API-Call Perspective) or whose BM25 similarity to the draft is high (Logic Similarity Perspective); Reduce phase feeds the filtered union to a larger target LLM with parallel/speculative verification decoding (Sec 3.2-3.4).
